title: AERF-EVIDENCE Receipt (v0.2)
description: Agent Evidence Receipt Format — EVIDENCE profile, v0.2.0-draft.1. DRAFT — not yet stable. See SPEC.md §4 and §4.6 for the normative description. v0.2 adds multi-agent verification fields (parent_signature, pdp_signature, context_hash_sha256, log_inclusion_proof, impact_tags) and closes held decision C-12.

id.description: Receipt identifier (UUIDv4 in v0.2; identifier format under review per held decision C-15).

type.description: Receipt profile discriminator. v0.2 ships only 'notarised_evidence'.

plan_id.description: UUIDv4 of the plan receipt this evidence references.

agent.description: Asserted identity of the acting agent.

action.description: Action being notarised. Charset: A-Z a-z 0-9 _ : . -

in_policy.description: Whether the action satisfied the plan's policy at observation time.

policy_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the policy decision.

evidence_hash_sha512.description: SHA-512 hex digest of the canonical JSON encoding of the 'evidence' object. Algorithm declared via field-name suffix per locked decision C-3.

observed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action was observed.

key_id.description: Identifier of the issuer's public key. v0.2 uses the first 16 hex chars of SHA-256(public_key).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the receipt with post-issuance fields removed (see SPEC.md §7).

previous_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical PAYLOAD of the previous receipt per locked decisions C-7 and C-24.

plan_signature.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature of the referenced plan receipt.

agent_signature.description: Optional signature by the acting agent's own key. Distinct from parent_signature.

agent_key_id.description: Key ID of the agent's signing key, when agent_signature is present.

policy_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of canonical {scope, checkpoints, delegates_to} of the plan. REQUIRED when pdp_signature is present.

output_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of canonical action output, when supplied.

compliance_tags.description: Generic compliance tags (locked decision C-14). Distinct from impact_tags.

parent_signature.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 counter-signature by the parent agent (SPEC.md §4.6, §16).

parent_key_id.description: First 16 lowercase hex chars of SHA-256(parent public key).

parent_evaluation_path_id.description: OPTIONAL declaration of the parent's evaluation path identity (SPEC.md §12.6).

pdp_signature.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature by the Policy Decision Point over the canonical JSON of {context_hash_sha256, in_policy, policy_hash} (SPEC.md §4.6, §17).

pdp_key_id.description: First 16 lowercase hex chars of SHA-256(PDP public key).

context_hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON of the input context observed by the agent.

log_inclusion_proof.description: RFC 9162-aligned audit-path inclusion proof against a conformant transparency log (SPEC.md §15). Added post-issuance.

impact_tags.description: Impact tags from the closed v0.2 core registry or the x-{vendor}- namespace (SPEC.md §17).
